integrity: Analytic proof for all integers n>=2; exact rational finite replay corroborates, rather than certifies, the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for a directed ring with one edge per season, one occurrence per period, and uniform recovery. Only local linear disease-free stability is proved; threshold nonlinear dynamics, global persistence, and stochastic outbreak behavior are not. General temporal-propagator literature and unlocated algebraic specializations create a residual novelty risk.
title: Cyclic ascent classification of seasonal epidemic invasion on a directed transmission ring
